title: Auto-create PR on task completion
userStory: As a developer, I want PRs created when tasks complete so that code review can begin immediately.
acceptanceCriteria: On task completion, user prompted to create PR
PR title from task title, body from task summary + acceptance criteria
PR URL stored on task record
Option to skip PR creation (for tasks that don't need it)
Works for both GitHub and GitLab workspaces
User can edit PR details before creation
